_comment: Comparison shown on the home and About pages. Facts about GSI and NDEM come from the sources listed below as checked on 2026-10-01; anything we could not confirm is marked [to verify] — check it before presenting. Edit this file to correct or update a cell.

rows.label: What it is
rows.gsi: Official landslide forecasts from the Geological Survey of India; the forecasting centre and its portal and app were launched in July 2024.
rows.ndem: Official geo-portal for disaster-management officials; login needed (access granted to authorised Central and State officials).
rows.br: Student prototype, not an official warning service. Follow official warnings first.

rows.label: Coverage
rows.gsi: 21 districts in 8 states in 2025; operational for Darjeeling and Kalimpong, experimental elsewhere (including Sikkim and Kohima). Nationwide system planned by 2030.
rows.ndem: All of India for its portal; landslide early warnings for pilgrimage routes in the north and north-east; past-landslide inventory 2012–2021 for some states.
rows.br: 25 monitoring points: 17 in Sikkim and the Darjeeling hills, 8 preview points across the North East (some terrain values still defaults).

rows.label: Detail level
rows.gsi: District bulletins; block-level areas reported for Darjeeling; other districts [to verify].
rows.ndem: Landslide hazard zonation maps and route-wise warnings; map scale [to verify].
rows.br: One live level per monitoring point; ~2 km road segments in the route checker; buildings, schools, health facilities and roads within 1 km (OpenStreetMap).

rows.label: Update frequency
rows.gsi: Daily forecasts through the Bhooskhalan app; season covered (monsoon only?) [to verify].
rows.ndem: Route warnings for the current day plus a two-day forecast; hazard maps are static.
rows.br: Weather every 30 minutes, risk recalculated every 15–30 seconds, forecast for +6, +12, +24 and +48 hours.

rows.label: Local languages
rows.br: English, Hindi and Nepali; Assamese, Mizo and Nagamese as drafts awaiting native-speaker review.

rows.label: Community input
rows.gsi: The app lets stakeholders share and update landslide occurrences; whether any citizen can report [to verify].
rows.ndem: Data exchange and chat among officials; no public reporting found [to verify].
rows.br: Residents report warning signs (cracks, muddy or new springs, tilting trees or poles, small rockfalls) with photo and location; officers verify; anonymised map layer for everyone.

rows.label: Offline use
rows.ndem: Web portal; needs a connection [to verify].
rows.br: Installable app; keeps the last risk data and viewed map tiles on the device and says “Offline — showing data from …”.

rows.label: Explainability
rows.gsi: Forecasts built on rainfall thresholds for each area; how reasons are shown to the public [to verify].
rows.ndem: Map layers; no per-place explanation found [to verify].
rows.br: “Why” card: time window, confidence and the top three reasons with their share of the score; a public replay of a real landslide shows the method and its limits.
